title: Jain-Friendly Roasted American Challots Grill
description: A twist on traditional American roasted dish, this recipe uses challots and confit-tomato, and is suitable for Jain diet.
instructions: Place a comal or a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 2 tbsp of olive oil to the comal and swirl to coat.
Add garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper to the comal and sauté for 1 minute.
Add confit-tomato to the comal and stir to combine.
Add challots to the comal, cut side up, and cook for 2-3 minutes or until they start to brown.
Transfer the comal to the oven and roast for 20-25 minutes or until the challots are tender and caramelized.
While the challots are roasting, mix together lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, and water in a small bowl.
Remove the comal from the oven and brush the challots with the lemon juice mixture.
Sprinkle cornmeal over the challots and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes or until the cornmeal is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and garnish with fresh cilantro.
